subject: [PATCH v3 1/2] memcg: reduce cacheline contention between lruvec stat updates and LRU lists

2026-10-23.patch_summary: This patch reduces cacheline contention between lruvec stat updates and LRU lists by rearranging the layout of struct mem_cgroup_per_node in memory. The goal is to minimize unnecessary cache line sharing, which can lead to increased lock contention and performance degradation. Specifically, it moves the 'memcg_pn_cold' group, which is only accessed during memcg reparenting or freeing, to be adjacent to the 'memcg_pn_read_mostly' group, allowing these two groups to share a cacheline instead of the LRU list heads. This change improves performance in multi-threaded workloads with high memory access rates.
